items.text: Closing, hiding and reloading an observer window leave ongoing work and outstanding approvals under main-process custody, with no stop or approval inferred from visibility loss. Verify REQ-001 with VER-001.

verification.text: Observe main-process child/session/request custody while a run has ongoing work and an outstanding approval. Close, hide and reload its observer window; compare execution/request observations before and after and inspect any emitted stop/approval action. Sources: CLM-002; V4-EXM-11. Implements AC-001.

items.text: An explicit native stop is distinguishable from observation loss, and the reported outcome reflects the observed interruption or remaining uncertainty, including any separately observed active descendant. Verify REQ-002 with VER-002.

verification.text: Invoke native stop deliberately and trace the request and observed provider result. Contrast an observer loss and an unavailable stop acknowledgment. Include a separately active descendant where the native supplier exposes one; verify the report does not infer its stop from primary-turn completion. Sources: CLM-002; V4-EXM-11. Implements AC-002.

items.text: Known requests support actual grants, denials, answers and explicit declines; their outstanding state is preserved across observation loss, and silence, timeout or recovery never becomes approval. Verify REQ-003 with VER-003.

verification.text: Exercise known request grant, denial, question answer and explicit decline using the selected native request types. Interrupt observation while a request is outstanding and restore it; exercise silence/timeout without granting permission. Compare actual replies and recovered outstanding state. Sources: SOW-063, SOW-064, SOW-122; V4-EXM-11. Implements AC-003.

items.text: An unknown server request receives an explicit error through the selected supplier interface; missing acknowledgment remains unobserved even if a reply write or local settlement occurred. Verify REQ-004 with VER-004.

verification.text: Supply an unknown server request at the supplier boundary and inspect its explicit error. Exercise an unavailable acknowledgment after reply writing/local settlement and check that the report makes no acknowledgment or success claim unsupported by observation. Sources: SOW-123, SOW-065; CLM-002. Implements AC-004.

items.text: After loss and restoration of connection, the recovered execution and outstanding-request state is grounded in Codex observations; stale local rendered/transcript state cannot establish an outcome. Verify the reconnect part of REQ-005 with VER-005.

verification.text: Disconnect and reconnect with outstanding work/requests and deliberately stale rendered or copied-transcript state. Compare recovered state with native Codex observations; retain uncertainty wherever actual outcomes cannot be recovered. Sources: SOW-062, SOW-124; CLM-002. Implements AC-005.

items.text: After App quit/relaunch or restart, the person can continue the conversation and access prior events, while recovered, currently outstanding and unavailable facts remain distinguishable. Verify the continuation part of REQ-005 with VER-006.

verification.text: Quit and relaunch the identified native App, then continue the conversation and inspect prior-event access and any outstanding/unknown state. Record actual supplier recovery behavior without assuming process survival during quit. Sources: SOW-008, SOW-066; V4-EXM-11. Implements AC-006.

items.text: The UI/evidence handoff preserves observed events and unknown outcomes, including a faithfully recorded actual human response with decision actor distinct from recorder. Fabricated human acts and stronger unsupported outcome claims are rejected; no additional act is inferred from execution, settlement, acknowledgment or recovery, and no independently evidenced act is erased merely because another act is absent. Verify REQ-006 with VER-007.

verification.text: Inspect the receiving state/evidence handoff for observed and unavailable outcomes. Include an actually supplied human answer/act recorded with its subject, actor and recorder distinguished, and negatives containing absent human evidence, transport-only success, lost acknowledgment and conversation-only recovery. Confirm execution, acceptance, checking, approval and reliance retain separate evidence; an independently evidenced act stays recordable without inventing other acts. Sources: CLM-004; REQ-006; V4-EXM-11. Implements AC-007 within this slice's handoff, not the sibling record schema.

items.text: The delivered fixtures and results cover this slice's window loss, explicit interruption, known/unknown requests, denial, timeout, reconnect, restart and missing-acknowledgment transitions against identified candidates, without substituting historical passes for current behavior. Verify REQ-008 with VER-008.

verification.text: Review the fixture inventory and candidate-bound result records against REQ-001…REQ-006 and the delivered code interfaces. Check coverage of the named transitions, actual executed/not-run standing and configuration identity; trace each asserted product result to its relevant observation. Sources: CLM-001; V4-EXM-01…05 and V4-EXM-11. Implements AC-008.

items.text: Documentation accounts for unknown outcomes, recovery/evidence interfaces, all four anticipated artifact classes, optional old-client reuse and the unresolved means, with the named receiving and decision owners retained. Required behavior remains covered whether reuse is selected or declined. Verify REQ-007 and REQ-009 with VER-009.

verification.text: Review the documentation against the accepted DEL-01-02 artifact/interface row, SOW-125, the clarification and current Architecture §3. Check the optional-reuse rationale, receiving responsibilities and open choices; trace each excluded act to CLM-003 or CLM-004 and its actual owner. Confirm the receiving supplier boundary stays stock/directly hosted and no transcript copy or local settlement is given unsupported authority. Implements AC-009.
